title: HP Victus 15-fb0040AX Gaming Laptop - i5, RTX 3050
description: HP Victus 15 gaming laptop with Intel Core i5-12450H, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 4GB, 8GB DDR4 RAM, 512GB SSD, 15.6-inch FHD 144Hz display, dual-fan cooling, backlit keyboard.

reviews.author: Kapil S.
reviews.title: Best gaming laptop under 60k
reviews.body: Runs all modern games at high settings. Thermal management is decent for the price.

reviews.author: Pooja M.
reviews.title: Solid performance
reviews.body: Fast SSD and smooth 144Hz display. Fan noise under load is acceptable.

reviews.author: Ravi K.
reviews.title: Average battery life
reviews.body: Gaming sessions drain battery quickly. Overall a good value laptop for the price.
